text.body:
tapasvino dānaśīlāḥ kulīnāḥ satyavādinaḥ | dharmapradhānā ṛjavaḥ putravanto dhanānvitāḥ | | 2.68 | |
tryavarāḥ sākṣiṇo jñeyāḥ śrautasmārtakriyāparāḥ | yathājāti yathāvarṇaṃ sarve sarveṣu vā smṛtāḥ | | 2.69 | |
strībālavṛddhakitava mattonmattābhiśastakāḥ | raṅgāvatāripākhaṇḍi kūṭakṛdvikalendriyāḥ | | 2.70 | |
patitāptārthasaṃbandhi sahāyariputaskarāḥ | sāhasī dṛṣṭadoṣaśca nirdhūtādyāstvasākṣiṇaḥ | | 2.71 | |
ubhayānumataḥ sākṣī bhavatyeko'pi dharmavit | sarvaḥ sākṣī saṃgrahaṇe cauryapāruṣyasāhase | | 2.72 | |
sākṣiṇaḥ śrāvayedvādi prativādisamīpagān | ye pātakakṛtāṃ lokā mahāpātakināṃ tathā | | 2.73 | |
agnidānāṃ ca ye lokā ye ca strībālaghātinām | sa tānsarvānavāpnoti yaḥ sākṣyaṃ anṛtaṃ vadet | | 2.74 | |
sukṛtaṃ yattvayā kiṃcijjanmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam | tatsarvaṃ tasya jānīhi yaṃ parājayase mṛṣā | | 2.75 | |
abruvanhi naraḥ sākṣyaṃ ṛṇaṃ sadaśabandhakam | rājñā sarvaṃ pradāpyaḥ syātṣaṭcatvāriṃśake'hani | | 2.76 | |
na dadāti hi yaḥ sākṣyaṃ jānannapi narādhamaḥ | sa kūṭasākṣiṇāṃ pāpaistulyo daṇḍena caiva hi | | 2.77 | |
dvaidhe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ sameṣu guṇināṃ tathā | guṇidvaidhe tu vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ ye guṇavattamāḥ | | 2.78 | |
yasyocuḥ sākṣiṇaḥ satyāṃ pratijñāṃ sa jayī bhavet | anyathā vādino yasya dhruvastasya parājayaḥ | | 2.79 | |
ukte'pi sākṣibhiḥ sākṣye yadyanye guṇavattamāḥ | dviguṇā vānyathā brūyuḥ kūṭāḥ syuḥ pūrvasākṣiṇaḥ | | 2.80 | |
pṛthakpṛthagdaṇḍanīyāḥ kūṭakṛtsākṣiṇastathā | vivādāddviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vivāsyo brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | | 2.81 | |
yaḥ sākṣyaṃ śrāvito'nyebhyo nihnute tattamovṛtaḥ | sa dāpyo'ṣṭaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet | | 2.82 | |
varṇināṃ hi vadho yatra tatra sākṣyanṛtaṃ vadet | tatpāvanāya nirvāpyaścaruḥ sārasvato dvijaiḥ | | 2.83 | |
